explanation: Does something in advance for later benefit, or leaves something in a certain state.
example_sentence: 旅行の前にホテルを予約しておきます。(I'll book a hotel in advance before the trip.)
drill_sentence: 会議の前に資料を準備して___。(おく)

explanation: Indicates a completed action, often with a nuance of regret or an unintended result.
example_sentence: 宿題を忘れてしまいました。(I completely forgot my homework.)
drill_sentence: 電車の中で財布を落として___。(しまう)

explanation: Try doing something to see what happens.
example_sentence: この料理を食べてみてください。(Please try eating this dish.)
drill_sentence: 新しい店に行っ___ましょう。(みる)

pattern: 〜てあげる / 〜てくれる / 〜てもらう
explanation: Verb forms expressing giving and receiving of favors -- あげる (I do it for someone), くれる (someone does it for me), もらう (I receive the favor of someone doing it).
example_sentence: 友達が引っ越しを手伝ってくれました。(My friend helped me move.)
drill_sentence: 先生が漢字を教えて___ました。(くれる)

explanation: Lists a few representative actions among others -- 'do things like X and Y'.
example_sentence: 週末は本を読んだり映画を見たりします。(On weekends I do things like reading and watching movies.)
drill_sentence: 公園で走っ___、写真を撮っ___しました。(たり／たり)

explanation: A conditional form -- 'if ~'.
example_sentence: 安ければ買います。(If it's cheap, I'll buy it.)
drill_sentence: 時間が___、手伝ってください。(あれば)

explanation: A conditional/temporal form -- 'if/when ~'.
example_sentence: 雨が降ったら、試合は中止です。(If it rains, the game will be canceled.)
drill_sentence: 家に着い___、電話してください。(たら)

explanation: Expresses a natural or automatic consequence -- 'when/if ~, then always ~'.
example_sentence: 春になると、桜が咲きます。(When spring comes, the cherry blossoms bloom.)
drill_sentence: このボタンを押す___、電気がつきます。(と)

explanation: A conditional based on a topic or the other person's statement -- 'if it's the case that ~'.
example_sentence: 日本へ行くなら、京都がおすすめです。(If you're going to Japan, I recommend Kyoto.)
drill_sentence: 車を買う___、新しいのがいいですよ。(なら)

explanation: Attaches to a verb/adjective stem to say something looks or seems a certain way based on appearance.
example_sentence: このケーキはおいしそうです。(This cake looks delicious.)
drill_sentence: 雨が降り___です。(そう)

explanation: Expresses an inference based on what the speaker has observed -- 'it seems that ~'.
example_sentence: 誰もいないようです。(It seems like no one is here.)
drill_sentence: 田中さんは風邪をひいた___です。(よう)

explanation: Expresses hearsay or an inference based on outside information -- 'I heard that ~ / apparently ~'.
example_sentence: 明日は雪が降るらしいです。(I heard it'll snow tomorrow.)
drill_sentence: 彼はもう国へ帰った___です。(らしい)

explanation: The passive voice -- the subject receives the action, often with a nuance of being affected or inconvenienced.
example_sentence: 電車の中で足を踏まれました。(My foot got stepped on on the train.)
drill_sentence: 先生に褒め___ました。(られ)

explanation: The causative voice -- makes or lets someone do something.
example_sentence: 母は私に部屋を掃除させました。(My mother made me clean my room.)
drill_sentence: 先生は学生に本を読ま___ました。(せ)

pattern: 使役受身形 〜せられる／される
explanation: The causative-passive -- the subject is made to do something, usually unwillingly.
example_sentence: 子供のとき、よく野菜を食べさせられました。(As a child, I was often made to eat vegetables.)
drill_sentence: 毎日残業___られました。(させ)

explanation: Introduces a name, quote, or piece of information -- 'called ~ / that ~'.
example_sentence: 田中さんという人から電話がありました。(There was a call from someone named Tanaka.)
drill_sentence: 台風が来る___ニュースを聞きました。(という)

explanation: Expresses that something happens occasionally, or (with た form) that one has had the experience of doing something.
example_sentence: 京都へ行ったことがあります。(I have been to Kyoto before.)
drill_sentence: たまに朝ご飯を食べない___があります。(こと)

explanation: Expresses a decision the speaker has made -- 'I've decided to ~'.
example_sentence: 来月から毎日運動することにしました。(I've decided to exercise every day starting next month.)
drill_sentence: 今年こそタバコをやめる___にします。(こと)

explanation: Expresses a decision or arrangement made by someone else or by circumstances -- 'it has been decided that ~'.
example_sentence: 来年、大阪に転勤することになりました。(It's been decided that I'll be transferred to Osaka next year.)
drill_sentence: 会議は来週に延期する___になりました。(こと)

explanation: Expresses the speaker's intention -- 'I intend to ~'.
example_sentence: 今度の休みに沖縄へ行くつもりです。(I intend to go to Okinawa this coming holiday.)
drill_sentence: 来年、大学院に進学する___です。(つもり)

explanation: States a plan or schedule -- 'scheduled to ~'.
example_sentence: 会議は三時に始まる予定です。(The meeting is scheduled to start at 3 o'clock.)
drill_sentence: 来月、新しい店がオープンする___です。(予定)

explanation: Expresses the speaker's strong expectation based on reason or evidence -- 'should be ~'.
example_sentence: 彼はもう着いているはずです。(He should have already arrived.)
drill_sentence: この時間なら、店はまだ開いている___です。(はず)

explanation: Expresses possibility -- 'might ~'.
example_sentence: 明日は雨が降るかもしれません。(It might rain tomorrow.)
drill_sentence: 彼は今日、来ない___。(かもしれない)

explanation: Expresses 'before doing ~' and 'after doing ~'.
example_sentence: 寝る前に歯を磨きます。(I brush my teeth before sleeping.)
drill_sentence: ご飯を食べた___、薬を飲みます。(後で)

explanation: Expresses that something happens within a limited window of time -- 'while ~'.
example_sentence: 子供が寝ている間に、家事をします。(I do housework while my child is sleeping.)
drill_sentence: 夏休みの___に、宿題を終わらせます。(間)

explanation: Expresses a change that has come about over time -- 'reach the point of ~ / come to ~'.
example_sentence: 毎日練習して、上手に泳げるようになりました。(I practiced every day and came to be able to swim well.)
drill_sentence: 最近、漢字が読める___になりました。(よう)

explanation: Expresses that something is not necessary -- 'don't have to ~'.
example_sentence: 明日は休みなので、早く起きなくてもいいです。(Since tomorrow is a day off, I don't have to wake up early.)
drill_sentence: 今日は残業し___です。(なくてもいい)

explanation: Attaches to a verb/adjective stem to mean 'too much ~ / excessively ~'.
example_sentence: 昨日、お酒を飲みすぎました。(I drank too much alcohol yesterday.)
drill_sentence: このカレーは辛___ます。(すぎ)

explanation: Attaches to a verb stem to mean 'easy to ~' or 'hard to ~'.
example_sentence: このペンは書きやすいです。(This pen is easy to write with.)
drill_sentence: この漢字は複雑で覚え___です。(にくい)

explanation: Expresses that the speaker wants someone else to do something -- 'I want you to ~'.
example_sentence: もっと野菜を食べてほしいです。(I want you to eat more vegetables.)
drill_sentence: 静かにし___です。(てほしい)
